items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So this group comes into town called the Jazz Crusaders. So Buddy invited them down that night... These guys come down to the club, they got Joe Sample

ctx.x: I was playing – I was playing with Buddy Collette’s quintet. We were playing down on Hollywood Boulevard at a place called Jazz City. So this group comes into town called the Jazz Crusaders. So Buddy invited them down that night, same day they got into town, they come on down to the club. These guys come down to the club, they got Joe Sample, they got um, what’s his name, he played the flute and the sax. Oh you know him
Well I know Wilton Felder, um Henderson? I’m thinking – I might be getting these folks mixed up. Anyways.
